title: Astro Portal API v1 — the public gallery
description: What a visitor reads of the public captures of every space: `GET /v1/gallery` (a page of the home gallery, newest night first) and `GET /v1/gallery/{captureId}` (one public capture, its detail page). Built field by field by `packages/portal/src/captures/public-capture-view.js`; `additionalProperties: false` at every level, so that nothing it does not name may leave: never the place, its name nor its coordinates, the day of the night (the month only), an e-mail address, a space or a person, the original file name, a device (the signature is the space's « Nom public », `null` without it). The published file is `GET /v1/gallery/{captureId}/media` (the copy without location, `?variant=thumbnail` its thumbnail). A capture that is not public answers 404 `capture_not_found`, the same as an identifier that never existed. See api/v1.md, section "The public gallery".

month.description: The month of the night, `YYYY-MM`: the session's start, otherwise the upload's date; for the image of a multi-night plan, the month of the first night it combines. Never the day.

target.description: A target of the catalogue: its designation, its name in the requested language, its first alias, its object type and constellation (the catalogue's stable French keys) and its J2000 position in degrees — the target's, never the place's.

tag.description: A generic tag of the galleries, derived from the object type of the first target (« Grand champ »: a capture without a catalogue target); the page translates it. The generic tags have **keys** (`x-keys`, the contract's word for each, shared by the web and the phone: the phone's ARB catalogues name them `genericTag<Key>`), and the French word stays the stored and transmitted value — `capture_tags.tag`, `galleryLabel`, a personal target's `label`, `tag` and `tags` here, `tags` and `ownTags` of the private gallery — so that no stored row nor installed app breaks. A capture takes its target's tag by default among its own tags, at its creation (`GET /v1/captures`: `tags`); an owner's own word that is none of these is written as it is, never translated nor normalised. `Messier` (key `messier`) is a generic word too, said of a target of that catalogue, never a default nor a label.

exposure.description: The integration of the capture, when it carries it (no source today: always `null`).

variantMedia.description: The two files of a public variant, selected on the media route by `imageId` (`variant=thumbnail` is the size).

item.description: One card of the home gallery.

nightMonthEnd.description: Additive: the last month of the nights a capture combines, only for the image of a multi-night plan whose nights span several months (`nightMonth` is then the first): the capture says « Août – septembre 2026 ». Absent for a capture of one night and for a plan whose nights fall in one month. Months only, never a day.

signature.description: The space's « Nom public », as its owner wrote it; `null`: the capture is unsigned.

skyQuality.description: The sky quality of the place as a Bortle class and where it comes from (measured at the place, typed by the observer, or the modelled estimate); never the place itself.

image.description: The pixel size of the published file.

imageQuality.description: The quality of an image as Astro Sync measured it on the stacked master, as a gallery says it — only while the owner's switch of that gallery is on (`captures.quality_public`, on for a capture created since this rule and off for older ones until their owner turns it on, for this public gallery; `quality_private`, on by default, for the private one), absent otherwise. `fwhmPixels` is the median full width at half maximum of the stars in pixels, `fwhmArcsec` the same in arcseconds (`null` when the pixel scale is not known), `eccentricity` between 0 and 1 (`null` when not measured), `starCount` the stars measured, `measuredOn` on what (`linear`: the master before any stretch), `measuredAt` when, `tool` the program and its version (`null` when unknown). Never a path, a file name, a night or a place.

progressionStep.description: One milestone of a capture's progression: the image Astro Sync stacked with `frameCount` frames (for the image of a multi-night plan, the image stacked after one night, `frameCount` the frames stacked up to that night). Its two files are selected on the media route by `imageId`, like a variant's. Never a date, a file name or a place.

night.description: What one night the capture combines says, as Astro Sync read it: the medians of the measured frames (`skyBackgroundAdu` the sky background in ADU, `fwhmArcsec` the stars' FWHM in arc seconds, `eccentricity` 0–1, `measuredFrames` the frames measured) and the guiding PHD2 logged (`rmsTotalArcsec`, `rmsRaArcsec`, `rmsDecArcsec` in arc seconds, `meridianFlips`), `null` where the report says nothing. Never a date, a session's identifier or a place: the page names the nights « Nuit 1 », « Nuit 2 » in their order.

qualityCharts.description: The catalogue's quality charts of the nights the capture combines (« Qualité des captures » and « Guidage et journal de la nuit », `CaptureQuality.js`), read from the nights' analyses with the Journal's functions: `series` the measured frames grouped in chronological points (48 at most for one night, 36 for several), each with its sky background relative to the darkest point (`backgroundRelativePercent`, 100 = the darkest), its median FWHM in pixels and eccentricity; `sessionTelemetry` one entry per night with guiding: its RMS, its counts of dithers, expired settles, focus runs and meridian flips, its guiding trace (`guideSeries`: the mean RA and Dec offsets and the RMS of each point, in arc seconds; empty when the night kept no raw sample) and its events. Every time is `fromMinute` / `toMinute` / `minute`, minutes since the night's first measure (several nights follow one another on one axis in `series`): never a date, a clock time, a session's identifier or a place.

capture.description: `GET /v1/gallery/{captureId}`: the card, plus the equipment of the night by kind, the sky quality and the pixel size of the published file. A row with no value is `null` (or an empty list) and is not drawn.

mainImage.description: The main image's own names — the first option of the menu « Image affichée » and the description under the image while it is shown. Written by the service; optional so that a reader of an earlier answer still validates.

title.description: The owner's title of this image (what he typed), `null` while he typed none: the reader then shows `generatedTitle` in its language, else the name by default (« Variante N », N its `arrivalRank`; « Image principale » for the main image): an option of the menu « Image affichée ».

description.description: The owner's description of this image, (what he typed), drawn under the image while it is the one shown; `null` while he typed none: the reader then shows `generatedDescription` in its language, else nothing.

generatedTitle.description: Additive: the title a producer generated for this image in the ten languages (capture-variant.schema.json `generatedTitle`); absent when none was. Shown in the reader's language while `title` is `null`.

generatedDescription.description: Additive: the description a producer generated for this image in the ten languages (capture-variant.schema.json `generatedDescription`); absent when none was. Shown in the reader's language while `description` is `null`.

arrivalRank.description: The rank of arrival of the image in its capture (every image counted, the private ones included), the number of its name by default; never a date, a file or a count.

variants.description: After the main image, the variants of the capture its owner made public, newest first — their two files (`?imageId=` of the media route) and their pixel size, nothing else. Written by the service; optional so that a reader of an earlier answer still validates.

skySolution.description: The sky solution of the main image, present only while it exists and the owner's switch « Afficher le plate solving » is on; absent otherwise (the page is the one of before).

progression.description: Additive: the progression of the capture, its milestones from the fewest frames to the most, shown with the capture (no switch of its own) and drawn by the panel's « Progression de la nuit » with its timed playback (`plan`: the image of a multi-night plan, each milestone after one night, « Progression de l’empilement »). Absent when the capture has none.

nights.description: Additive: the nights the capture combines, in their order, under the same switch as `quality` (« Afficher la qualité en public »); absent while it is off or no night was analysed. Drawn in « La nuit » / « Les nuits » and « Guidage » after « Qualité ».

qualityCharts.description: Additive: the charts of what moves through the nights the capture combines (`qualityCharts`), under the same switch as `quality`, drawn above the values of `nights`; absent while it is off or no night was analysed.

quality.description: The quality of the main image, present only while it was measured and the owner's switch « Afficher la qualité en public » is on (on for a new capture); absent otherwise. Drawn in the « Qualité » section of the panel.

metadata.description: The capture's metadata for a visitor; absent on an answer written before it. Optional so that a reader of an earlier answer still validates.

list.description: `GET /v1/gallery?locale=&query=&tag=&offset=&limit=&order=`: a page (24 by default, 48 at most) of the public captures, newest night first (`order=oldest` reverses it); `total` after the filters, `publicTotal` every public capture; `tags` the generic tags present.

title.description: The owner's title of this image (what he typed), `null` while he typed none: the reader then shows `generatedTitle` in its language, else the name by default (« Variante N », N its `arrivalRank`; « Image principale » for the main image): an option of the menu « Image affichée ».

description.description: The owner's description of this image, (what he typed), drawn under the image while it is the one shown; `null` while he typed none: the reader then shows `generatedDescription` in its language, else nothing.

generatedTitle.description: Additive: the title a producer generated for this image in the ten languages (capture-variant.schema.json `generatedTitle`); absent when none was. Shown in the reader's language while `title` is `null`.

generatedDescription.description: Additive: the description a producer generated for this image in the ten languages (capture-variant.schema.json `generatedDescription`); absent when none was. Shown in the reader's language while `description` is `null`.

arrivalRank.description: The rank of arrival of the image in its capture (every image counted, the private ones included), the number of its name by default; never a date, a file or a count.

private.description: Additive, only in the answer to the owner of a private gallery (`GET /p/{token}/{captureId}`): `true` for a variant that is not public — the owner reads every variant of his capture there, a draft included — drawn with the badge « privée ». Never written for a visitor, who is given the public variants only; absent means public.

skySolution.description: The sky solution of this public variant, under the main image's rule; a variant without one shows no annotations and hides nothing of the main image's.

quality.description: The quality of this public variant, under the main image's rule (the owner's switch « Afficher la qualité en public » is on and Astro Sync measured it); absent otherwise.

visitorMetadata.description: A capture's metadata as a visitor reads it — its own title (`null`: the targets' label) and description, the acquisition per filter (no origin), its total, the calibration, the sensor, the processing, the filters' names and the Moon's illumination at the night's date. **Never** the place, the notes, an origin, `edited`, `finalizedAt`, the file name, the fingerprint or the dates of sending. A value absent has no line.
